spec_match.rationale: Contrasts the spec's real event homes — gattserverdisconnected on BluetoothDevice (unchanged) vs connection-level events on the newly-EventTarget server — and detects each via its exact surface (own ongattserverdisconnected handler attribute; prototype parent check).

interactive.rationale: Four buttons drive real EventTarget dispatches with a live log, a once:true re-attach toggle with aria-pressed state, and per-fire explanations that change with observed behaviour.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a side-by-side with a clearly-labelled plain-EventTarget re-enactment; the page banner states 'Illustration only … no radio is involved' before any control.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers Web-Bluetooth-absent, pre-157, and the once-spent-listener case (firing after once:true shows the not-heard branch and explains reconnect re-attachment).

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, MDN gattserverdisconnected, PR 672 preview and adjacent concepts linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's device-disconnect-event-still-on-device assertion pins this page's migration contract; the synthetic dispatch is deliberately not asserted as Bluetooth behaviour.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Same-origin driver clicked every button on headless Chromium 141: both dispatches logged, once:true spent-listener branch reproduced, aria-pressed toggled, clear reset the log; console clean; both viewports screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on detection, both fire buttons (with heard/onceMode detail) and the once toggle.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the labelled-illustration banner uses accent-blue on stone at AA; long-token buttons wrap via max-width + overflow-wrap after the 360px overflow fix.

accessibility.rationale: The toggle exposes aria-pressed and renames itself; the dispatch log is an aria-live labelled list; code samples are focusable pre blocks; all controls keyboard-native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: A real 19px overflow at 360px (long event-name button label) was found by measurement and fixed with max-width:100% + overflow-wrap:anywhere; re-measured scrollWidth 360 and re-screenshotted both classes.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the detection column on a 157 build with Web Bluetooth enabled
openQuestions.detail: On this Linux build both availability lines honestly read 'no — Web Bluetooth absent'. On Chrome 157 (or Canary with the CL) confirm the device column reads yes via ongattserverdisconnected and the server column flips to yes via the prototype-parent check, with the explanatory output updating to the both-patterns-live sentence.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates with aria-live regions for async operations
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Toggle buttons must expose pressed state programmatically and event outcomes should be announced as text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The once:true toggle sets aria-pressed and updates its accessible name; dispatch outcomes land in an aria-live log plus an aria-live explanation output.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls layout without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Constrain intrinsic-width controls with max-width and allow long tokens to wrap so flex rows never widen the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied directly as the fix for the measured 379px scrollWidth: buttons carry max-width:100% and overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified back to 360.

summary: Migration page: measures which listener home exists via exact surfaces, then re-enacts both dispatch patterns with plain EventTargets under an explicit illustration-only banner. The one real defect found in this build wave (long button label overflowing 360px) was caught by measurement and fixed.
